Chapter 1301: 43: My Turn

Chapter 1301: Chapter 43: My Turn

“Is this the means of a demon god?” Lin Yuan looked at the Demon God, intending to stall for time.

Now, five Eternal Sources are continuously refining, with a large number of particle worlds being opened up every moment. Lin Yuan’s strength is rapidly increasing, and he’s naturally prepared to stall until the particle worlds are fully developed.

Only by then can Lin Yuan’s strength reach its peak, giving him the confidence to confront the Demon God.

As for now?

From that previous strike, Lin Yuan knew that he wasn’t currently a match for the Demon God.

Of course, not being a match doesn’t mean he can’t hold off. With Lin Yuan’s current methods, if he focuses purely on defense, the Demon God would find it difficult to deal with him in a short time.

Boom!

The Demon God glanced at Lin Yuan momentarily, and then a deep, dark point formed at the single horn on its forehead.

The next moment, it shot towards Lin Yuan.

“Hmm?” Lin Yuan furrowed his brows.

He wanted to drag out the time until he completely opened up the particle worlds.

But the Demon God wasn’t a normal being. It only acted on instinct and naturally wouldn’t waste words with Lin Yuan.

The momentary pause earlier was merely out of surprise at Lin Yuan’s existence.

“Sizzle—”

The deep, dark point pierced through the outer universe barrier and landed on Lin Yuan.

Compared to the corrosive effect of the black aura, the deep, dark point shot from the single horn of the Demon God was pure destructive force.

The outer universe barrier didn’t even have a chance to recover before it was penetrated.

Lin Yuan’s figure staggered back several steps, a wound appearing on his chest, yet it was quickly healing.

Physical Body Divine Ability — Blood Droplet Rebirth.

This life-saving divine ability hadn’t been put to use for a long time.

“Luckily, I asked for an extra Eternal Source.” Lin Yuan blocked the deep, dark point from the Demon God, thinking to himself.

This strike nearly pierced through Lin Yuan’s physical body, reaching the point where recovery means had to be employed.

With the Eternal Source present, the Blood Droplet Rebirth divine skill could be continuously utilized. Unless Lin Yuan’s entire body was obliterated in an instant, he wouldn’t die.

Lin Yuan once again looked at the Demon God.

Boom!

He saw the enormous, pitch-black tail behind the Demon God give a gentle shake, as if the heavens and earth were collapsing, lashing towards Lin Yuan.

Previously, in the secret world, the power of the giant tail behind the Demon God was also immense, almost causing the entire secret world to tremble slightly.

“Bang!” The boundless force struck Lin Yuan’s physical body.

Lin Yuan condensed his outer universe, raising his defense to the highest level. Even so, he clearly felt the impact on his physical body, with numerous cracks appearing on the surface of each particle world.

However, as ‘Blood Droplet Rebirth’ operated, all the cracks swiftly recovered and vanished.

“Lord Galaxy…”

In the secret world, all the strong figures were extremely shocked.

If blocking one strike from the Demon God could be considered a lucky fluke,

then now, Lord Galaxy continuously withstood three strikes from the Demon God. These three strikes were meant for attacking the secret world, but they were all fended off.

Even if Lord Galaxy appeared slightly miserable for it, the sect masters’ hearts were filled with a tremendous storm.

“Sizzle sizzle—”

“Boom boom boom!!”

“Bang bang bang!!!”

What followed was the Demon God launching a new round of attacks, starting with the black aura, then the deep, dark point, and finally the giant tail lashing, all falling on Lin Yuan.

Lin Yuan did his utmost to withstand, striving to deflect the force, completely adopting a defensive stance, warding off the Demon God’s successive attacks.

As the Demon God attacked, it also looked down on Lin Yuan from a high vantage, its hollow eyes revealing a slight hint of interest.

Compared to the tortoise-shell-like secret world, Lin Yuan was evidently more interesting now. At least while fending off its attacks, there was varying feedback in terms of injury.

However.

The next moment.

Just as the giant tail behind the Demon God was about to lash Lin Yuan again.

A giant hand suddenly grasped the Demon God’s giant tail.

At the same time, Lin Yuan, who had been enduring the attacks, slowly stood up.

“Had enough yet?”

Lin Yuan’s giant hand tightened around the giant tail, effortlessly suppressing the immense resistance, his aura entirely different from before, as if countless Constant Sand Worlds resonated in unison. Then he fiercely pulled the giant tail back.

“Now it’s my turn!”
